title: Model A — simple request/response (POST /v1/intents directly)
description: Bare minimum Model A flow. No ScenarioBundle, no workflow DAG. The initiator calls POST /v1/intents with to_agent pointing to an existing SA address. The agent receives via stream, runs real echo logic, calls resume_intent. The initiator observes completion via observe().

agents.description: receives intent via stream, reflects payload back with metadata
